toegepas.voor: Soos by elke bron kyk jy
toegepas.na: Soos by elke bron, kyk jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: The two 'by' phrases run together; a comma after the fronted comparison lets a Grade 4 reader see where the main clause starts.
toegepas.fout: The fronted elliptic comparison 'Soos by elke bron' runs straight into 'kyk jy by aanlyn inligting', so two 'by' phrases blur and a Grade 4 reader can stumble over where the main clause begins.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma after a fronted (reduced) subordinate clause is normal Afrikaans punctuation, marks the start of the main clause, and changes nothing in the meaning or the protected wording.

laat_vaar.voor: Grawe is een van die maniere
laat_vaar.na: Om te grawe is een van die maniere
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A bare infinitive as subject reads stiffly at Grade 4; 'Om te grawe' is the natural Afrikaans form and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A bare infinitive as subject ('Grawe is een van die maniere') is correct, natural Afrikaans, and this is a glossary definition, so a lateral stylistic rewording should not be made.

vlae.teks: 'n Ou pot wys waarvan mense geëet het.
vlae.rede: 'waarvan mense geëet het' is ambiguous: it can mean what people ate or what they ate from ('waaruit'). Choosing between 'wat mense geëet het' and 'waaruit mense geëet het' would guess the intended content, so this goes to the writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Answer to the entry's explicit question, not an objection: 'voorwerpbron/voorwerpbronne' is a regular, transparent Afrikaans compound (like 'voorwerpnaam' or 'bronnelys'), correctly closed up, and a nine-year-old who knows 'voorwerp' and 'bron' will read it without difficulty. It may not be in a dictionary, but it is well-formed Afrikaans and fits the set beside the other three. No change proposed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Jy sien ook die huise en vervoer
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Jy sien ook die huise en die vervoer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Repeating the article before the second noun reads more naturally in Afrikaans.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: One article governing both nouns reads naturally here; repeating it is a lateral move.
